sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Fuinjutsu, Earth Release, Wind Release, Fire Release, Water Release, Lightning Release, Bio Branch

system.description:
You reach out and touch your Bio-Pet, infusing them with Synthetic chakra, emulating the raw power of nature as they grow 2 size categories, their physical body begins to emit elemental chakra until a physical manifestation of that nature release is visible on their body (Jolts of lightning, billowing flames, gouts of water or floating stones). They gain the following benefits for the duration.

The Bio-Pets Bite or Tongue Lash attack deals +2d6 Cold, Earth, Fire or Lightning damage, your choice when you command them to attack.

The Bio-Pet can cast Jutsu you know, of C-Rank and lower with the nature release keywords this jutsu has, using your highest jutsu attack bonus/Save DC for any calculation it requires. It can cast jutsu in this way using the Cast command, but since it does not have Jutsu slots, it must spend 1 Charge of a preexisting ability it has.

The Bio-Pet gains immunity to Elemental conditions for the duration.

The Bio-Pets abilities that require charges, gain +1 charge.
